reason: Schleswig is small, I walk pretty much everywhere and it costs me nothing. It's almost November, so it's going to be cold and rainy and I wouldn't ride anyway. If I really wanted a bike I'd just fix the flat on my own one.
objection: In winter and rain I won't ride anyway, so even 5 € a month would just be gone for nothing. And with only 10 bikes there probably isn't one near me when I actually want one.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial month in spring, or a bike guaranteed near my school, so I could test it when the weather is good.
